contexts.text: The fig-tree withered away ()... To wither away = no longer any truth and good.
Hence it is that to the east wind are ascribed withering, and drying up; withering = where there is no good; and drying up, where there is no truth. Illustrated.

I will dry up all their herb () = that the truths which are from these goods will perish. I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools = that the intelligence and the Knowledge of truth will perish.
